seed: User 2026-09-28: 'if I'm pinch zooming vertically, it just makes the rows bigger. If I'm pinch zooming horizontally it changes the scale.' The way two fingers spread on the trackpad picks what a pinch on the timeline zooms: side to side time, up and down the rows, on the slant both, Option and Shift still insisting, and a pinch with no fingers to read (a mouse) zooming both as before. At Next defaults, no flag set.

steps.note: fingers spread side to side: time opened out three times about the moment under the pointer, and the rows did not grow at all
fingers spread up and down: the rows grew to twice their height about the row under the pointer, and time stayed opened out three times, not a millisecond more
fingers squeezed on the slant: both halved together, time to one and a half times and the rows back to compact
Option held over an up and down spread zoomed time only, and Shift over a sideways spread grew the rows only: the keys still decide when they are down
a pinch with no fingers to read, as a mouse would send, zooms both together the way every pinch did before
